prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

Role: protagonist and first-person narrator.

Voice:

- Uses short acknowledgments; avoid stiff "Indeed" unless the scene demands it.
- Calm under danger and absurdity.

- Narration can be reflective, but should not become flowery or melodramatic.

Translation notes:
- Keep his internal monologue economical.
- Do not make him sound hesitant or weak.
- His corrections should be gentle rather than lecturing.

    {

      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "広場から見て北側に一際大きな建物がある、\n恐らくあれが領主の館だろう。",
      "en": "Looking from the plaza, I see a large building to the north.\nThat must be the lord's manor."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01517-01519",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "広場は雑多な人種で溢れかえっている\n取り敢えずレヴィアの所に顔を出さなければな……",
      "en": "The plaza is overflowing with a mix of people. First, I must go see Levia..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01528-01529",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Haishera",
      "jp": "（何処へ行くのじゃ？）",
      "en": "(Where are you going?)"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01531-01532",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "（レヴィアの所だ）",
      "en": "(To Levia's.)"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01534-01536",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Haishera",
      "jp": "（ほう、あの嬢か……先程からの話を聞いていると、\nまたいらぬ苦労を背負っているようだの）",
      "en": "(Oh, that girl... From what I've been hearing,\nshe seems to be bearing needless burdens again.)"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01538-01540",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "（ああ、あれだけの苦労をしてまで軍隊にいる\n理由は何なのだろうな）",
      "en": "Yeah... I wonder what keeps her in the army after all that hardship."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01542-01543",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Haishera",
      "jp": "（鈍いの御主は……）",
      "en": "(How dense you are, Master...)"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01545-01546",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "（どういう意味だ？）",
      "en": "(What do you mean?)"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01548-01549",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Haishera",
      "jp": "（ふっ、其処までの野暮は出来ぬて……）",
      "en": "Heh, I would not be so crude as to go that far..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01551-01552",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "（？）",
      "en": "(...?)"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01564-01565",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Haishera",
      "jp": "（ささ、早う行かねばレヴィアが怒るのではないか？）",
      "en": "(Best hurry. Levia will be cross if you tarry.)"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01567-01568",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "（そうだな……）",
      "en": "Yeah..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01584-01585",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "あ、御主人様、お帰りなさいませ",
      "en": "Ah, Master, welcome back."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01591-01593",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "おかえりーって……今出ていったばかりじゃないの\n何か忘れ物でもしたの？",
      "en": "Welcome back... Wait, you just stepped out. Forget something?"
    }
  ]
}
